BiblicalUsage: Jeremiah speaks this word to Edom, and it is a word of terror. Edom's terribleness has deceived her, the pride of her heart has told her she is safe in the clefts of the rock, but the Lord says He will bring her down from her high nest.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse unmasks a common lie: a fearsome reputation can deceive the very people who hold it.
